{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to secp256k1 build files follow directly from vendoring experimental crypto modules rather than changes to Core's build system.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Does not address Core build or CI infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation edits in doc/descriptors.md and doc/psbt.md are secondary documentation accompanying the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Doc updates merely support the CISA implementation rather than being the primary change."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp only for regtest consensus deployment flags.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Does not touch the kernel API or architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches policy files only for witness version 2 standardness rules associated with the soft fork.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Standardness rules follow directly from the proposed consensus soft fork rather than general mempool behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches mining_basic.py only as a follow-up test adjustment.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "No block template or mining interface logic is modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches p2p_segwit.py purely for test maintenance.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "No P2P network transport, message protocol, or relay logic is altered."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "RPC file changes only expose descriptor and rawtransaction support for CISA.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "RPC adjustments are secondary interfaces for the consensus and wallet features."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes add functional test coverage for CISA rather than framework or harness infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Adds feature-specific tests, which belong to the areas tested rather than test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Vendors unmerged experimental modules directly into secp256k1 specifically to support BIP460.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Subtree changes are a prototype bundling of upstream secp256k1 PRs for the BIP reference implementation rather than Core utility library maintenance."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements consensus script verification and check queue batch validation for BIP460 CISA under witness version 2.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides the reference implementation for BIP460 cross-input signature aggregation consensus rules to enable technical review of the soft-fork proposal. Under the validation rubric, proposed soft forks are validation PRs whose importance lies in deciding whether the consensus logic is correct. Aggregate signatures significantly alleviate witness weight growth and fee penalties for multi-input transactions."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds descriptor expressions (cisa() and rawcisa()), PSBT fields, and signing logic to the wallet using half- and full-aggregation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Implements prototype wallet support for creating and signing aggregated transactions. While clear in utility for collaborative spend schemes like CoinJoin, wallet integration for an unactivated experimental soft fork is deferrable relative to active production wallet needs."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
